# GREETING CARD

#  Materials used :

* Colour paper  
* 1 LED  
* 1 3V coin battery  
* Aluminium foil  
* Glue , crayons ,scissors .etc.,

## Procedure :

First, we planned to design our greeting card by using color papers . we drew a lamp in that paper and we coloured it to feel more attractive.

Then, we made a simple circuit inside the card. We connected the LED to the 3V coin battery using by aluminium foil, We checked if the positive side of the battery was connected to the positive side of the LED and the negative side was connected to the negative side.

As a result, the LED lights up, making the greeting card more attractive and interesting.

### Working Mechanism :

The coin battery provides electrical energy. When the circuit is closed, electric current flows from the battery through the LED and back to the battery. The LED converts this electrical energy into light energy. We also created a simple switch mechanism in the card. When the switch is pressed, the circuit gets completed and using terminals ion flows through foil and glows. If it is switched OFF then it does’nt glows.

#### Conclusion :

This project helped us to understand the basic usage & mechanism of components, including a battery, LED, and a switch. It also showed us how simple electronics can be used creatively in everyday objects.
